units.source_text: 母亲从背囊里将大米掏出来，说：这是送给老师的。

en.t: Mother took the rice out of her knapsack and said, "This is for the teacher."

units.source_text: 母亲取出了用旧灰色丝棉包了好几层的父亲的灵牌，放在我的书架上。

en.t: Mother took out Father's memorial tablet, wrapped in several layers of old gray silk cotton, and placed it on my bookshelf.
